title: Website and backend history is complete again
summary: The changelog lists every website and backend release since October 7, and each new release now adds its own entry when it goes live.
items: Changelog → Website and backend shows the releases from October 8 to October 23, grouped by day, each with its published source and its verification and live checks.
From now on, every website or backend change adds a plain-language note that appears here when that release goes live.
